lines.trans: Mathias, are you ready to leave?
Yes, the doctors are letting me leave.
You have to wear this heart monitor?
Yes, to monitor my heart rate.
I am so happy for you.
Listen, the device is already beeping softly!
It is because you are moved!
I don't beep for everyone.
It is proof of your affection.
You mean a lot to me, Camille.
Promise me to be very careful.
I will finally change my habits.
Let us walk together toward the exit now.
Thank you for being here with me.

examples.trans: It is a sign of affection.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
qui est à l'appareil? = who's calling?

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many
to beep, emit an electronic beeping sound
cardiac, related to the heart or heart conditions

examples.text: Il a eu une crise cardiaque.

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
changer de + noun without article: changer d'agent

examples.text: Des gens comptent sur ce film.
examples.trans: People are counting on this film.

meanings.en: compter sur = to count on, to rely on

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

examples.trans: I have to see the play.

examples.text: Ça va, si je parle doucement.
examples.trans: I'm fine, if I speak softly.

examples.text: Elle avait déjà pris sa décision.
examples.trans: She had already made her decision.

meanings.note: tu es déjà venu? = have you been here before?

meanings.en: as a noun: the whole, a set

meanings.note: pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

meanings.en: d'habitude / comme d'habitude = usually / as usual

examples.text: Je suis très heureux pour vous.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
for machines and plans: ça marche = it works / okay
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
merci beaucoup = thank you very much

examples.text: Tu as besoin d'un nouveau médecin!

meanings.note: aller chez le médecin = to go to the doctor's
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

examples.text: Parce que tu ne peux pas.

meanings.note: no object: je pars = I'm leaving
partir en vacances = to go on holiday

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

meanings.note: invariable in plural: un pas, des pas
porter malheur = to bring bad luck; porter bonheur = to bring good luck

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.
Il doit faire preuve de respect.

meanings.en: faire preuve de = to show, to demonstrate (a quality)

examples.trans: To slow down the work pace.

examples.text: Si tu veux le rôle, tu dois changer.
examples.trans: If you want the part, you have to change.

meanings.note: ça sonne bien = it sounds good
la sortie d'un film = a film's release
la sortie de secours = the emergency exit

examples.text: Il a disparu une semaine avant la sortie.
examples.trans: He has disappeared a week before the release.

examples.text: Si Kadropov sort avec une belle femme comme toi, il le dit à tout le monde!
examples.trans: If Kadropov goes out with a beautiful woman like you, he tells everyone!

meanings.note: passé composé with 'être': elle est sortie

meanings.en: sortir avec quelqu'un = to go out with someone, to date

surveiller.gloss: to watch over, to look after

examples.trans: I will watch over the offices.

meanings.note: used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi
informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes
takes a singular verb: tout le monde est là
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
écoute = listen, look (to start a point)

examples.trans: I'm very moved (said by a woman).

meanings.note: past participle of 'émouvoir' used as an adjective
